cr_stage2.source: engineering-default: removable Cr oxide cartridge sits between Fe condenser and SiO baffles with intermediate capture surface

sio_stage3.source: engineering-default: removable SiO baffle cartridge needs the largest capture surface among named stages

alkali_stage4.source: engineering-default: cyclone separator effective wall area exceeds throat but stays below SiO baffle cartridge

terminal.source: engineering-default: terminal vent/capture area is not the constriction; keep >= throat for follow-on Kn diagnostics

authority_exclusion.reason: K2O remains excluded from the openimcc activity authority above the cap by owner ruling of 2026-09-26, retained pending re-evaluation under the D066 pack (t-1194). The original ruling was established using published-core. For loaded pack default (IMCC-SF04-D066, version 1.0.3-d066-v1, digest 02c88c04fe09f8f494adda8a76e1f95fee536d11b2b6d66639aaea097fce5e75), KCaAlSi2O7 is inactive at 1473 K and inactive at 1673 K, with Gamma(KO0.5) values 1.67e-6 and 9.44e-6. Zhang et al. (2021, ACS Earth Space Chem.) measured alpha*Gamma(KO0.5) = 6.9e-8 at 1473 K and 1.11e-6 at 1673 K for the cited N-MORB-like basalt. At this evaluated above-cap input, the OpenIMCC over constant-gamma K2O activity step is -0.47 dex. Constant-gamma K is also uncertified (t-999).

authority_exclusion.reason: K2O remains excluded from the openimcc activity authority above the cap by owner ruling of 2026-09-26, retained pending re-evaluation under the D066 pack (t-1194). The original ruling was established using published-core. For loaded pack default (IMCC-SF04-D066, version 1.0.3-d066-v1, digest 02c88c04fe09f8f494adda8a76e1f95fee536d11b2b6d66639aaea097fce5e75), KCaAlSi2O7 is inactive at 1473 K and inactive at 1673 K, with Gamma(KO0.5) values 1.67e-6 and 9.44e-6. Zhang et al. (2021, ACS Earth Space Chem.) measured alpha*Gamma(KO0.5) = 6.9e-8 at 1473 K and 1.11e-6 at 1673 K for the cited N-MORB-like basalt. At this evaluated above-cap input, the OpenIMCC over constant-gamma K2O activity step is -0.03 dex. Constant-gamma K is also uncertified (t-999).

reported_activity_provenance.melt_oxide_gamma_limitation: constant_gamma_table_value with endmember continuity shell starting at asserted X=0.99; gamma is a shipped mid-range constant (CaO/Al2O3/SiO2/TiO2/Cr2O3/MgO/MnO: rounded geometric midpoint of the Sossi & Fegley 2018 Table 2 printed envelope, not a cited point coefficient; Na2O/K2O: cited point anchors); no one-parameter pseudo-binary mid-range regular solution and no A*T*/T temperature scaling of gamma (held for multi-component G^E / MC-5); as X approaches 1 the shell enforces Raoultian a->1 continuously so the former gamma*X to a=1 step (31.1x for Cr) is absent; when valid_range_K is set, a temperature outside that interval remains flux-driving and status-bearing; when valid_range_K is unset, this module attaches no in_domain/out_of_gamma_domain payload

shadow_trace.context: Path A: Continuous pN₂ ramp extracts Na/K/Fe/SiO₂. Path A_staged: staged pN₂ ramp separates alkali, SiO, hot Fe hold, then cool Na cleanup. Path B: pO₂-managed Fe-only pyrolysis preserving CMAS glass for tapping as Material 1.
Branch Two (preferred): C4 Mg pyrolysis + final C2A boiloff. Branch One (fallback): skip C4 and complete pyrolysis-only when optional C5/MRE is disabled.
